meta.name: nanoresearch-planning
meta.description: Produce an experiment blueprint from a research hypothesis

copy.tagline: 将研究假设转化为实验蓝图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从假设出发设计实验方案
copy.tagline_en: Turn a research hypothesis into an experiment blueprint
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design an experimental plan from a hypothesis

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 根据研究假设，自动生成详细的实验蓝图，包括数据集、基线方法、评估指标和消融实验设计。
howto.when: 当用户提供研究假设并完成构思阶段后，需要制定实验方案时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个假设设计实验方案。
列出适合验证这个假设的数据集。
say.note: 技能会推荐候选数据集。

howto.what_en: Automatically generates a detailed experiment blueprint from a research hypothesis, including datasets, baselines, evaluation metrics, and ablation study design.
howto.when_en: Triggered after the user provides a research hypothesis and completes the ideation phase, when an experiment plan is needed.

say_en.text: Design an experiment plan for this hypothesis.
say_en.note: The skill will generate an experiment blueprint.

say_en.text: List suitable datasets for this hypothesis.
say_en.note: The skill will recommend candidate datasets.
